artifact_findings: All eight dot-card, five-frame, grouping, and comparison items were independently evaluated as 3, 5, 4, 2, 4, 5, >, and <, matching the key.
The study guide accurately models four distinct subitizing strategies and supplies separate try-it items.
rationale: The worksheet is mathematically correct, focused on recognizing quantities to five without one-by-one counting, and well supported by an unusually useful guide. Typography is somewhat small and the three-page worksheet is generous with whitespace, but it remains clear and usable.
